summary: Iteration 36 'Add Payment' dialog overhaul fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 55/55 pytest pass (including 3 new test_add_payment_v2.py cases: new_fee_types_accepted, sc_adjusted_creates_tx, sc_adjusted_routes_through_agent_ledger). Frontend: header button renamed to 'Add Payment' (data-testid=add-payment-btn) — legacy add-entry-btn absent. PaymentDialog opens with default fee type 'Admission Fees'; Collected-in shows pay-collected-type=College Acc. + pay-collected-account. Fee Type dropdown exposes exactly the 7 required options in order: Application Fees, Registration Fees, Admission Fees, Tuition Fees, Uniform Fees, Other Fees, SC Adjusted. On selecting SC Adjusted the dialog switches: pay-collected-type/account vanish, pay-collected-client appears grouped by Sub-Agent/Associate, Associate Consultant, KM BLR Office, KM TCR Office (no staff clients present), the adjustment block disappears, helper text 'Sub-Agent · Consultant · KM Office'. Picking a sub-agent renders 'Selected: <name>' preview. Save (amount 1234) closes the dialog, new payment row in Payments table shows received-in chip 'Sub Agent Acc. ATHUL KRISHNAN - SAMI' with ₹1,234.00. GET /api/transactions confirmed an auto-logged income tx (type=income, amount=1234.0, account_id set, linked_student_payment_id matches). Edit-flow: pencil pre-fills fee_type=SC Adjusted, amount=1234, client preview re-selected. Switching back to Admission Fees reverts UI: pay-collected-type+account return and adjustment block reappears.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentDialog.jsx — branching on fee_type=sc_adjusted is clean. Consider extracting the SC-Adjusted received_in payload builder into a small helper to keep submitPay tight (low priority).

Backend _resolve_default_account_id falls back to 'any' account if no cash/bank exists; logged tx will still post but on an arbitrary account. Worth surfacing a warning in the audit log so super admin notices misconfigured offices (nice-to-have).
Dialog uses a native <input type=date> (browser default picker) instead of shadcn Calendar — consistent with existing screens but flagged per design guideline.

FEE_TYPE_OPTIONS keeps booking_admission/tution/other legacy keys server-side for back-compat. Confirmed historical rows still deserialise; recommend adding a one-off migration script in the next iteration to normalise stored values.
